brief: build/visual_gaps/briefs/common.md + coordinator brief (2026-11-12): empty pedestal + three shop statues of the leader (GDD design/gdd/street-view.md 3.2 Buyable, 3.3, 5).
lighting_note: The game lights the street with one ambientLight (3.4, #e2d8be), no directional light, no vertex colours: every face shows its albedo flat. All form (recesses, edge wear) is baked into the albedo; the metals are driven by a per-vertex exposure ramp (see metal_ramp_rule).
palette_hint: Street textures are mid-value, photo-ish, slightly desaturated (public/textures/map/building2.png, stone.png). The metals may go darker (bronze) and brighter (gold) than the street: they are the punchline. Look at public/textures/map/billboard.png for the propaganda tone.
units: Blender Z-up, game units (citizen 6.66 tall). -Y faces the Street camera.

env_statue_pedestal.tiles: none (strips tile along U only; the rest are decals)
env_statue_pedestal.look: Grey-pink polished granite plinth (Soviet monument granite), weathered: rain streaks, grime at the base, a few bird droppings for comedy. Mid values (granite luminance 95-130).

die.look: The tall die faces, mapped once over their height (image top = top of the die, under the cornice). Grey-pink granite: grey base with black, salmon-pink and white crystal speckle (1-2 px grains), faint polish mottling. Top 3 px: shadow under the cornice. 10-15 rain streaks running down from the top, darker and a touch green-grey, 10-40 px long. Bottom 8 px: damp grime band, ragged top edge, splash specks. No joints (monolithic die). The pedestal's top face also maps here, rows 6-54 at about 11 px per unit (the statues stand on it).

cap.look: The cornice. Rows 0-7: the sloped face under the cornice lip (seen from above-ish: lighter, dusty, a few white bird-dropping splats near row 0-2). Rows 8-15: the vertical cornice face, the same granite a touch lighter than the die, an incised 1 px groove at row 11, chipped bottom edge, short drips below the splats.

step.look: The two base steps. Rows 0-7: the tread (top surface, seen from above): dusty lighter grey granite, blown dirt, a few dark leaf bits. Rows 8-23: the riser: rougher flamed grey granite, darker than the die, chipped top edge, dirt rising from the bottom 5 px.

plaque.look: A blank cast-bronze plaque (the text is localized UI: NO text, no glyph marks). Raised 2 px frame: bright worn edge on its top-left and outer rim, dark groove inside; dark brown patina field with faint mottling; four round rivet heads 2 px in the corners; verdigris (blue-green) seeping from the bottom frame and the rivets in short drips.

wreath.tiles: none (7 ring segments of 9.9 px along U)
wreath.look: The wilted funeral wreath unrolled: U runs round the ring (7 segments), image top = outer edge, bottom = inner edge. Laurel leaves 3-5 px, pointed, overlapping, dried olive-brown and khaki, a few still dull green, dark gaps between them, a few leaves curled to grey. Sad, not festive.

ribbon.look: The wreath's sash ribbon tail: once red, now faded to dusty rose-brown, a 2 px faded ochre stripe 3 px in from each long edge, water stains, a frayed V-cut at the bottom (the bottom 3 px darker).

env_statue_bronze.look: Patinated statue bronze: dark chocolate-brown body, bright brassy wear where hands rub and edges stand out, blue-green verdigris in the folds and recesses, darkest at the very bottom of the ramp.

env_statue_silver.look: Silver plate: bright cool silver on the exposed surfaces, near-white edge wear, grey-blue to blue-black tarnish in the recesses with a few warm brown tarnish blotches.

env_statue_gold.look: Gilt, gaudy: saturated yolk-gold body, pale lemon-white edges with a few white sparkle pixels, deep orange-brown recesses (old gilding over red bole showing in the folds).

ramp.look: An exposure ramp: image row = exposure (row 1.5 = most exposed: edges, tips, convex up-facing; row 42.5 = deepest recess: folds, armpits, between the legs, the horse's belly). Base tone falls through the metal's ramp keys; mottled 2D noise (cells 4-8 px) so a face spanning a few rows reads as cast metal, faint brushed grain along U, pits/specks; recess colour (verdigris / tarnish / red bole) creeps in below exposure 0.45 as ragged fractal patches, fully in the bottom 8 rows. No directional highlight.

face.look: The leader's face, frontal, image top = top of the head's front (under the cap band), bottom = chin. In the same metal: mid tone base; dark eye sockets (2 ellipses 3x2 px at row 6-8) under a bright brow ridge, bright nose ridge (2 px wide, rows 6-11), bright cheekbones, a big bushy moustache (12 px wide, rows 11-14: bright top edge, dark underside), dark mouth line under it, bright square chin. Stern and silly.

medals.look: A chest plate crowded with medals: dark coat tone background; 4 rows of 3-4 ribbon bars (3x2 px, alternating mid/light) with round medals (2-3 px, bright) hanging below them; a big 7 px star at the top left. Bright rims, dark gaps.

polish.look: Rubbed-shiny metal (tourists kiss the boot toe; cap badge; the horse's nose): the brightest tone of the metal, smooth with soft mottling, no recess colour.

metal_ramp_rule: For every ramp face the modeler computes a per-vertex exposure t in [0,1] (hemisphere occlusion against the whole statue, its pedestal and a ground plane, plus convexity): v = 1 - (1.5 + (1 - t) * 41) / 64. U is world-planar along the face (about 6 px per unit) and wraps; a small per-face V drift (<= 3 px) breaks banding. Decal faces (face, medals, polish) map inside their rect with a 1.5 px inset.

model_envelope.origin: centre of the pedestal footprint on the ground, z = 0
model_envelope.pedestal_square: 6 x 6 footprint (step 1 half 3.0), top at z = 5.0
model_envelope.pedestal_long: 12 x 6 footprint (X x Y) for the equestrian statues, same design, same heights
model_envelope.facing: -Y (the Street camera); figures and plaques face -Y
